description: The Key Variable Loader (KVL) 4000 PIKE2 provides security services for the KVL 4000. The KVL 4000 is a portable key distribution device that consists of a Personal Digital Assistant (PDA) and Security Adapter that connects to the PDA. The KVL 4000 allows programmers to generate, transport, and load encryption keys, securely and efficiently into secure communication products thereby enabling secure encrypted communications.
